result.rationale: In AddGuestsDialog.tsx, handleAdd calls setIsInvalidEmail(true) on validation failure, but the only reset is in the Cancel button handler (setIsInvalidEmail(false)). On a subsequent successful safeParse, the flag is never cleared, so the error banner persists during and after a successful mutation. Mechanism verifiable in the diff.

judged_text: isInvalidEmail is set to true on validation failure but never cleared on a subsequent successful validation, so the red 'emails must be unique and valid' banner persists after the user corrects the input and while the mutation runs. A user who types one bad email, fixes it, and re-submits sees the error message remain next to valid emails, making them believe the add failed even though the mutation succeeds; the flag only resets on Cancel/Cancel-close.

adjudication.rationale: In `AddGuestsDialog` (new file), `isInvalidEmail` is set to `true` when `ZAddGuestsInputSchema.safeParse(multiEmailValue)` fails in `handleAdd`, but it is never reset to `false` on subsequent successful validation or before triggering the mutation. The only reset is in the Cancel button handler (`setIsInvalidEmail(false)`). Therefore, after a user corrects the emails and re-submits, the red error banner (`{isInvalidEmail && ...}`) will still render while the mutation is pending and until the dialog closes on success, matching the reported persistent-error behavior.
